section:
### A further comparison between arms

Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 14.3 | 7.2 | 200 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 13.0 | 6.5 | 200 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
